quest.title: Wanmin Fresh
quest.description: Wanmin Restaurant has taken a custom order that now awaits delivery...
quest.rewards_formatted: Mora x20000, Mystic Enhancement Ore x2

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Sure, go do what you have to. I'll get someone else...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Please be careful while you deliver the food, and <color=#00E1FFFF>do not touch anything strange, or use your wind glider</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Otherwise, I fear that the Mora Meat might stop having any meat in it altogether...

talks.objective: Deliver the food to Curious Zi'rui

dialogues.speaker: Curious Zi'rui
dialogues.text: Why isn't the food here yet? It's been ages...

dialogues.speaker: Curious Zi'rui
dialogues.text: Oh, finally! Thank you so much.

dialogues.speaker: Curious Zi'rui
dialogues.text: I've still got some distance to go after this.

dialogues.speaker: Curious Zi'rui
dialogues.text: *sigh* There aren't a ton of interesting rocks here, either...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: That's right. A kid named Zi'rui ordered Mora Meat from us.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: He wanted us to deliver it to a place near Luhua Pool.

dialogues.speaker: Chef Mao
dialogues.text: Since I have my hands full manning the restaurant at the moment, could you help me with that delivery?

dialogues.speaker: Curious Zi'rui
dialogues.text: Why isn't the food here yet? It's been ages...
